title.rendered: Offshore iOS Development: A Guide for Business

content.rendered:
In today’s competitive app market, mobile applications play a key role in connecting businesses with their customers. With over a billion iOS devices in use globally, creating a high-quality and performing iOS product is more than just a competitive edge – it’s a necessity. This is reconfirmed by StatCounter: iOS holds a 29.67% market share with over 1.64 million applications out there, placing second behind Android.

However, iOS development comes with challenges, including finding skilled software specialists, managing budgets and timelines. And this is where offshore software development comes into play. This may be a game-changing solution for projects that want to leverage global talent and cut high development costs – without compromising on quality and development time.

What’s even more exciting is that the offshore approach makes it possible to excel in related niches. Games, business, and education are the top three categories in the Apple App Store. And offshore iOS development allows companies to tap into skilled professionals from around the world who specialize in creating business-specific iOS applications. This approach to development is incredibly flexible. It ensures that your project is built using the latest technologies and best practices.

This guide explores the core services offered by offshore iOS development teams. We’re going to compare the pros and cons of in-house development vs. offshore strategies. And also focus on possible team setups that can align with your business objectives. Whether you’re a startup looking to launch your first app or an established company – understanding the nuances will empower you to make informed decisions and find the right offshore iOS development partner with maximum ROI.

Who Are Offshore iOS Developers?

Offshore iOS developers create applications for Apple devices, such as iPhones, iPads, and Apple Watches, from remote locations around the globe. They should be experienced with programming languages like Swift and Objective-C and proficient in using Apple’s development tools such as Xcode, Core Data, and ARKit. Unlike in-house developers, offshore developers operate remotely from countries with robust tech talent pools and lower cost of living – offering a good balance between price and quality.

When Should You Go for Offshore iOS Development?

Choosing offshore iOS development can be an ideal solution for optimizing development costs, access to software specialists with specific skills / technologies, cover fluctuating / seasonal workloads, or cope with aggressive deadlines. Below are the most common benefits and solutions you can count on with this model.

Top iOS App Development Services for Your Project

When it comes to offshore software specialists, they can provide a wide range of iOS application development services tailored to meet various iOS project needs. These core services cover the entire lifecycle of mobile development, ensuring a comprehensive approach that transforms your vision into a high-quality and fully functional application. Below are the main ones:

  • iOS UI/UX Design. You can get a user interface that contributes to user-friendliness and structured information architecture. Offshore talents often provide a good way to find skilled designers who understand Apple’s design guidelines and create visually appealing, intuitive interfaces loved by users.
  • Custom iOS App Development. Create tailor-made solutions that align with your business goals. Whether it’s a simple utility app or a complex enterprise solution, offshore iOS app developers ensure a tailor-made app is uniquely designed to meet user needs.
  • iOS Software Testing. Ensure your application works as expected. QA specialists conduct comprehensive testing, including compatibility checks for apps developed with frameworks such as React Native.
  • Deployment. Get a helping hand for every aspect of deployment, from configuring provisioning profiles and signing certificates to ensuring compatibility across multiple Apple devices. Ensure a successful launch that aligns with your business goals, maintaining optimal performance.

Factors Influencing iOS Developer Compensation

The compensation for iOS developers can vary significantly based on a range of factors. Consider technical skills, the level of experience, the developer’s location, and the type of engagement. Understanding these factors can help you strike the right balance between cost and quality, ensuring successful project outcomes while staying within budget.

Highlight:

When deciding between hiring in-house iOS developers or offshore teams, the cost factor matters just as much as quality. The average cost for in-house developers will include hefty operating expenses, making them far less competitive vs. offshore iOS developers.

Salaries of iOS Developers in Different Countries

One of the key considerations for offshore iOS development is understandably the cost of hiring. Common rates vary significantly based on factors such as location, expertise level, and the tech stack. Whether you’re hiring iOS developers locally or offshore, understanding the approximate salary ranges for iOS developers (Junior and Middle, to Senior) in different regions can help you make a more informed decision.

In the United States, iOS developers are among the most highly paid professionals in the tech industry, with the annual salary found within $107,000-160,000. In Canada, salaries are slightly lower but still relatively high, with iOS software specialists making up around $85,000-154,400 annually. In Western Europe, countries like Germany and the UK have lower compensation for iOS developers, with the annual numbers found within $52,100-100,000 and $50,000-92,400 respectively. 

Countries in Latin America offer some of the most affordable iOS development services, with an annual average salary range of $12,400-25,600 (Brazil), which can come up to $50,000 for an experienced senior developer (our own case). Eastern Europe is known as a hub for cost-effective iOS development talent, offering high-quality services at lower costs. For example, in Poland iOS developers can earn annually $41,000-71,000 on average, and in Ukraine – $26,000-56,000.

Understanding these cost dynamics can help you make informed decisions when building a development team or boosting your in-house project with remote expertise.

Highlight:

Eastern European and Latin American countries offer way more favorable rates than Western European and North American ones. Countries like Poland and Ukraine offer a good pool of top-quality experienced iOS talents with diverse backgrounds and the best price / quality ratio.

Possible Team Setups in Offshore iOS Development

By selecting the right team setup, you can achieve your development goals faster while maximizing productivity and staying within budget. The team configuration depends on your project’s size, complexity, and goals. If you want to hire iOS developers, check out the possible teams that can be assembled based on your project needs.

Each of these basic team setups can offer unique advantages depending on the specific needs of your project. Mobilunity specializes in helping companies looking for the optimal team configuration, providing access to talents with expertise in iOS app development. Whether you need a dedicated team for a large-scale project, or smaller projects that don’t require the full-time involvement of certain specialists like a Project Manager or DevOps engineer – Mobilunity can help you get a tailored talent solution that combines technical excellence with cost efficiency.

Benefits of Integrating Offshore iOS Developers with In-House Teams

Working with an offshore team blended with in-house developers is an effective strategic approach. This type of development offers the best of two worlds, a good balance in terms of cost-efficiency, scalability, and expertise. Below are some of the key benefits of this hybrid offshore model.

Enhanced Productivity

Integrating freelance offshore iOS developers with your in-house resources will help you get the necessary expertise and tackle project tasks more efficiently, ensuring consistent 24/7 progress.

Sharing Knowledge & Skills

Your team can learn new specialized expertise, while offshore teams gain insights into the company’s processes and goals, creating a mutually beneficial partnership.

Efficient Risk Management

Outsourcing iOS development eliminates some of the risks, such as technological challenges or tight deadlines. This allows you to improve risk management, as the offshore provider is equipped to handle a significant part of them.

Cost Optimization

You can optimize the time and resources for hiring, onboarding, and managing in-house developers. In addition, you can achieve significant cost savings due to lower salaries, ensuring efficient resource allocation.

Potential Challenges of Offshore iOS Development

Offshore iOS development is a popular choice for businesses that need to optimize and give a spur to their mobile app projects. However, like any strategy, it comes with its own set of potential drawbacks. Below is a breakdown of the risks associated with offshore iOS development – backed with possible mitigation strategies.

Best Practices to Hire Offshore iOS Developers

Success in offshore development depends on efficient communication, clear expectations, and streamlined processes. With the right partner and approach, remote software specialists can become invaluable assets in achieving your project goals. Below are some best practices to ensure a productive partnership, and maximize the benefits of offshore iOS development while minimizing potential risks.

Set Clear Project Goals & Requirements

Start by outlining your project’s objectives, timeline, deliverables, and technical requirements. Provide detailed expectations and technical specifications – this will help both parties minimize misunderstandings and ensure alignment with your vision.

Choose the Right Offshore iOS Development Partner

Research potential vendors, review their portfolios, and check client testimonials. Trusted providers have a proven track record of delivering high-quality iOS development services, ensuring that you get only skilled professionals.

Establish Effective Communication

Use tools like Slack, Microsoft Teams, or Zoom for daily check-ins, progress updates, and discussions. Establish a schedule for regular meetings, even across different time zones, to ensure everyone is engaged and stays on the same page.

Promote a Collaborative Team Culture

Treat your offshore developers as an extension of your team. Encourage collaboration, share company goals, and involve them in key decisions. Remember, building trust and a sense of belonging boosts motivation and productivity.

Address Time Zone Differences Proactively

While time differences can sometimes create challenges, they can also be an advantage for 24/7 development cycles. Establish overlapping hours and provide clear instructions for work that needs to be done asynchronously.

Plan for Scalability

Offshore development teams can be quickly scaled up or down based on your project’s requirements. So, think about scalability in advance – and you’ll be able to onboard additional developers or reduce resources without disrupting the project.

Provide Regular Feedback

Offer constructive feedback to your remote developers to help them improve and align with your expectations. Celebrate milestones and highlight achievements to keep morale high and keep building a positive working relationship.

Focus on Long-Term Collaboration

Consider building a strategic relationship, rather than viewing your offshore development as a one-time solution. Eventually, a dedicated offshore team that understands your business and technical requirements can deliver consistent value in the long run.

Ensure Post-Development Support

Discuss support and maintenance requirements with your offshore partner early during the first stages of engagement. Ensure they can provide ongoing assistance after deployment to address bugs, feature updates, and future releases.
